conditions: Steady constant-density flow in a single conduit with no leaks or branches; v1 and v2 are net cross-section-averaged normal velocities oriented downstream.

evidence: Mass conservation in a fixed control volume bounded by impermeable walls and two cross sections gives equal incoming and outgoing mass rates in steady flow. With the same constant density at both sections, cancel density to obtain A1 v1=A2 v2.
Reference checked 2026-11-27: https://openstax.org/books/university-physics-volume-1/pages/14-key-equations. Proposed maintainer approval, not independent human certification.
